segments.name: Soft Wheat
segments.description: Produces and sells soft wheat flour used to make desserts and sauces, serving food manufacturers and other customers.
segments.evidence: The Soft Wheat segment includes the production and sale of soft wheat yielding flour that is used to make desserts and sauces.

segments.name: Durum Wheat
segments.description: Produces and sells hard wheat flour used to make pasta for customers in Morocco and export markets.
segments.evidence: The Durum Wheat segment includes the production and sale of hard wheat yielding flour that is used to make pasta.

segments.name: Couscous and Pasta
segments.description: Secondarily processes wheat into couscous and pasta sold to end customers.
segments.evidence: The Couscous and Pasta segment includes the secondary processing of products including couscous and pasta sold to end customers.

revenueModel.text: End customers and other buyers pay the company for wheat flour, couscous and pasta it produces and sells.
revenueModel.evidence: The Couscous and Pasta segment includes the secondary processing of products including couscous and pasta sold to end customers.

changes.text: In 2024 the company initiated a plan for the potential disposal of several assets and businesses as part of a Morocco and soft wheat focus.
changes.evidence: As part of its new strategy with a Morocco and soft wheat focus, the Company initiated in November 2024 a plan for the potential disposal of several assets and businesses.

changes.text: In 2025 the company completed the sale of a subsidiary operating in logistic activities.
changes.evidence: In August 2025, the Company completed the sale of its 100% equity interest in a subsidiary operating in logistic activities for total consideration of $ 8,286 .

changes.text: In 2026 the company completed the sale of long-term assets of a durum wheat mill located in Casablanca.
changes.evidence: In March 2026, the Company completed the sale all long-term assets belonging to a durum wheat mill with a capacity of 240 tons per day, located in Casablanca, Morocco for total consideration of approximately $ 18,700 .
